legend.available: Works from the plugin runtime now.
legend.bridge: Runtime method exists; it needs a TelegramUI bridge to affect live UI.
legend.promise: Returns a Promise because the Telegram engine operation is asynchronous.
legend.permissions: API v2 plugins can declare // @api 2 and // @permissions chat,messages,media,ui,events,network,account,settings,proxy,unsafe.

namespaces.name: ui

methods.example: GGAPI.ui.addFloatingButton({ title: "+", position: "bottomRight", offsetY: -120, draggable: true }, () => {})

config.x: Absolute x coordinate in the chat view.
config.y: Absolute y coordinate in the chat view.
config.position: topLeft, topRight, bottomLeft, bottomRight, centerRight, center.
config.draggable: When true, long-press and drag saves the button position.

methods.example: GGAPI.ui.addChatListHeaderButton({ title: "TON", icon: "diamond", color: "#0098EA", placement: "trailing", after: "proxy" }, handler)

namespaces.buttonConfig: Unified button config (flat fields): title, icon (SF Symbol name), color, backgroundColor, textColor, cornerRadius, borderColor, borderWidth, alpha, fontSize, shadow, displayMode ('icon'|'text'|'icon-text'), width, height, position, offsetX, offsetY, draggable. addChatListHeaderButton also supports placement ('leading'|'trailing'), before/after (proxy|compose|story|accountSwitcher) and order. Note: custom (animated) emoji renders in sent text but not inside native button titles.

namespaces.name: network
namespaces.description: Trusted plugin networking with fixed app stability limits.

methods.proxy: options.proxy: 'telegram' | 'active' | proxy id | { type:'socks5', host, port, username?, password? }. SOCKS5 only; MTProxy returns an error.

methods.description: Like fetch but routes through the current Telegram SOCKS5 proxy.
Set a default proxy (string keyword/id or {socks5} object) applied to all subsequent fetches; pass null to clear.
Resolve the current proxy settings snapshot (requires the proxy permission).

namespaces.name: settings
namespaces.description: Ghostgram settings bridge and local plugin settings.

methods.example: GGAPI.settings.define({ title: "Auto Proxy", items: [{ key: "enabled", title: "Автопереключение", default: true }] })

namespaces.name: plugins
namespaces.description: Cross-plugin event bus and runtime metadata.

namespaces.name: timers
namespaces.description: Timer helpers cleaned on plugin stop.

namespaces.name: users
namespaces.description: Safe local user and peer lookup. Requires users.read-basic, users.read-profile, or peer.read.

methods.example: const peer = await GGAPI.users.selectUser({ title: "Pick user", includeBots: true })

methods.signature: addSection({ id, title, placement, peerTypes, items }, handler)
methods.example: GGAPI.profile.addSection({ title: "Plugin", peerTypes: ["user"], items: [{ id: "id", title: "ID", value: "123" }] })

namespaces.name: messageStyle
namespaces.description: Local-only message decorations. Does not alter server messages or copy-protection.

namespaces.name: text
namespaces.description: Rich-text builders. Produce { text, entities } payloads (incl. Telegram Premium / custom emoji) for chat.sendText / replyText / sendSilent / scheduleText / setDraftText / insertText.

methods.description: Build { text, entities } from strings / styled parts / custom-emoji parts, computing UTF-16 offsets automatically.
